subject: English
title: The Quiet Lake：字義與堰塞湖（原第39～40題）
question:
【原第39題｜英文第39題｜still與earth的一字多義】
A language learner, Ze-You, takes some notes after reading the poem. The words “still” and “earth” each have two different meanings. What can he draw in boxes A and B to show the different meanings?

(A) A：海浪；B：磚牆
(B) A：海浪；B：土堆
(C) A：安靜坐著的人；B：磚牆
(D) A：安靜坐著的人；B：土堆

【原第40題｜英文第40題｜堰塞湖如何形成】
Which is the best way to explain a landslide-dammed lake?

(A) People build a tall wall to stop a river. Water stays behind the wall.
(B) Sometimes the land moves. Water collects in the low area and turns into a lake.
(C) Rocks or mud fall from a hill or mountain and block a river. Water collects behind it.
(D) A lake has no river going out. Water stays in the lake and can become heavy over time.
answer:
【原第39題｜英文第39題｜still與earth的一字多義】
正確答案：D。still 除了「仍然」還有「靜止的」；earth 除了「地球」還有「泥土」，應配靜坐者與土堆。

【原第40題｜英文第40題｜堰塞湖如何形成】
正確答案：C。山坡或山上的土石崩落、堵住河道，上游水體受阻累積，符合堰塞湖的形成。
explanation:
【原第39題｜英文第39題｜still與earth的一字多義】
一、先讀已給的筆記
still 的另一格寫 Even so / yet，表示「即使如此、然而」等轉折意思；earth 的另一格畫地球。因此空格要補不同的另一義，不能重複填仍然或地球。

二、回詩句判意思
The lake stays still 與 Its face is still 都描述湖面靜止、平靜，故 A 應畫安靜坐著的人。A wall of earth 指土石形成的阻隔，其中 earth 是泥土，故 B 應畫土堆。

三、對照四組圖
只有 D 同時符合「靜止」與「泥土」。原卷選 A，海浪與磚牆雖出現在湖或堤的聯想中，卻不是這兩個單字在此處的另一個意思。

【原第40題｜英文第40題｜堰塞湖如何形成】
一、把複合字拆開
landslide 是山崩；dammed 是被攔阻；lake 是湖。合起來指山崩物質堵住河道所形成的湖。

二、回原詩找形成過程
High in the mountains, the rocks push hard；A wall of earth；A river once ran free and fast, now held back, it cannot pass。這些句子描述土石成為天然阻隔，讓原本流動的河水被擋住。

三、保留因果順序
土石崩落→堵塞河道→水在阻塞處上游累積成湖，符合 C。B 只說低地積水，遺漏河道被堵塞；原卷選 B，應補上這個必要條件。

passage:
The Quiet Lake

The lake stays still under the sky,
Its water level, like glass close by.
The sunlight shines on the waves,
And trees move slowly in the wind.

It looks so safe, it looks so nice,
A clear, shy mirror resting there.
Birds fly over, the water shines,
Showing mountains, clouds and skies.

High in the mountains, the rocks push hard,
A wall of earth, very strong.
A river once ran free and fast,
Now held back, it cannot pass.

Heavy rain falls from the sky,
Clouds get dark, the wind moves slow.
The lake is calm, but still it rises.
Its strong power waits, quiet and new.

People walk along the road,
They see the lake, they do not know.
They do not see the wall may fall,
The earth may shake, the lake may break.

A landslide-dammed lake appears so small,
But it can hurt both one and all.
Its face is still, a calm place,
Yet strong power waits hidden too.

So when you go to this quiet lake,
Remember still is not all safe.
Think about the lake, its strong power,
Its calm is a mask; the lake hides its power.

字詞：mirror 鏡子；calm 平靜的；hidden 隱藏的；poem 詩。

optionAnalysis.label: A
optionAnalysis.text: People build a tall wall to stop a river. Water stays behind the wall.
optionAnalysis.explanation: 這是人為築壩攔水的描述；原詩說山中的土石阻擋河流。

optionAnalysis.label: B
optionAnalysis.text: Sometimes the land moves. Water collects in the low area and turns into a lake.
optionAnalysis.explanation: 只說地動後低地積水，沒有說明崩落土石堵住河道這個關鍵。

optionAnalysis.label: C
optionAnalysis.text: Rocks or mud fall from a hill or mountain and block a river. Water collects behind it.
optionAnalysis.explanation: 山坡或山上的土石崩落、堵住河道，上游水體受阻累積，符合堰塞湖的形成。

optionAnalysis.label: D
optionAnalysis.text: A lake has no river going out. Water stays in the lake and can become heavy over time.
optionAnalysis.explanation: 缺少崩塌物阻塞河道的成因，不能用沒有出流河道或水變重來定義堰塞湖。

teachingComic.title: 崩落、堵河、蓄水，三步讀懂堰塞湖

panels.heading: ① landslide：土石從山坡崩落
panels.text: 原詩提到山中岩石與A wall of earth。C進一步說明rocks or mud從山坡落下；不是人們築起的高牆。
panels.alt: 概念俯視圖，山坡土石正往流動河道落下，藍箭頭指水流、棕箭頭指土石移動。

panels.heading: ② block a river：土石堵住河道
panels.text: 關鍵是崩落土石擋住原本流動的河水。原詩的held back與cannot pass，對應C的block a river。
panels.alt: 同一概念河段被天然土石堆橫向堵住，無人造壩體；下游河床留白，不把土石當成低地積水。

panels.heading: ③ Water collects behind it.
panels.text: it指堵河的土石阻塞物；behind it就是水被擋住、在上游一側累積成湖。B只說低地積水，漏掉堵河這個必要成因。
panels.alt: 湖水在土石阻塞物左側上游擴大，右側標示下游；示意形成過程，不給實地湖深與尺度。

fourth.answer: 答案 C：土石堵河，上游蓄水
points: landslide → block a river → water collects。
A是人造高牆，不是原詩的天然土石阻塞。
D沒交代山崩堵河；湖水變重也不是本題定義。
